page_note: 本页为《European Innovation Scoreboard 2025》第57页，含一段正文与Figure 22：按创新维度分组的四类创新群体水平分组条形图，附图例与注释。

heading.title: Innovation performance of the innovation groups per dimension

components.evidence: four bars per dimension slot, one per innovation group, e.g. 141/119/85/54 for Human resources
dimension names sit on the left axis and bars grow rightwards to the 0-160 scale
colour keys 'Emerging innovators ... Innovation leaders' in a row under the axis title
numbers such as '151', '124', '83', '42' printed just past each bar end
'Adjusted score per dimension in 2025' under the axis; ticks are bare 0-160
'Adjusted score per dimension in 2025' set below the 0-160 tick row
'Note: Average scores for each performance group are defined as the unweighted average...'
long left-axis labels like 'Investments in information technologies', 'Resource and labour productivity'
note: 'adjusted such that the unweighted average of the four groups for each dimension equals 100'

new_components.name: reversed_series_order_vs_legend
new_components.evidence: bars within a slot run Innovation leaders (top) to Emerging innovators (bottom); legend lists the reverse order
new_components.why_it_matters: 读值时若按图例顺序对应条形会错位，需按从上到下的实际绘制顺序把141归给Innovation leaders而非Emerging innovators。

difficulty_notes: 所有48个值都直接打印在条端，读数不成问题（步骤2无阻）；难点在寻址：一个值需要“维度名+群体名”两个键，而12×4的表必须同时给出12个长行名与4个列名；更关键的是122在图中出现三次（Sales and employment impacts/Innovation leaders、Trade impacts/Innovation leaders、Firm investments/Strong innovators），105、85、122、119等数字重复，若表格行列标签缺失或系列顺序按图例反排，就无法把122唯一定位到某一条。
